text.p: Tropical Cyclone Ophelia is becoming less of a threat to shipping. The storm is in the South Indian Ocean about midway between Java and the Northwest Australia coast, moving east at 7 mph. Top winds are 50 mph and will continue to weaken as the storm moves eastward, dissipating within 24-48 hours. The threat to the Northwest Australia coast has diminished but we will continue to watch this weather system.

Tropical Depression 41W is a minor to moderate threat to shipping in the Southern South China Sea. The depression has 35 mph winds and is centered near 5n/109e, moving west at 8 mph. It should remain over open water while moving slowly westward this period, with little change in strength.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
